summary.text: Jed Lipsky is an independent state representative from Lamoille-1 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jed Lipsky was born in Massachusetts, lives in Stowe, Vermont, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Colorado.
His career experience includes working as assistant director of the Conservation Society of Southern Vermont and as a logger.

While living in Monterey, Massachusetts, Lipsky served on the selectboard, planning board, and school board, and after moving to Vermont he served on boards and committees including the Stowe School Board and the Stowe Land Trust Board.
Lipsky assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, succeeding Heidi Scheuermann.
